summary: Procure and map vendor seat entitlements for Research Data team (split billing across two cost centers)
number_of_seats: 75 total (50 full-time research + 25 contractor ephemeral pool)
justification: Research Data team needs additional analysis seats for Q2 experimentation and a temporary contractor pool to support a 10-week external data labeling engagement. Seats must be SCIM-enabled and tagged to two cost centers for accurate chargeback.
description:
Issue summary:
The Research Data org requests procurement of 75 SaaS seats from AcmeAnalytics: 50 permanent researcher seats and 25 ephemeral contractor seats. The purchase must be invoiced and attributed across two cost centers (RD-Analytics and RD-Platform) with a 60/40 split. SCIM/SSO provisioning and role-based groups need to be configured before the contractors start on 2026-04-15.

Impact:
- Delayed access will block two analytics projects with hard milestones in April-May (feature extraction and labeling QA).
- Contractors cannot be onboarded without ephemeral seats mapped to the transient contractor pool.

Requirements:
- Purchase 75 seats under Redwood corporate account with invoice line items split as RD-Analytics 60% / RD-Platform 40%.
- Enable SCIM provisioning and map groups: RD-Researchers, RD-Contractors.
- Add billing tags: cost_center:RD-AN, cost_center:RD-PL.
- Provide one consolidated invoice and monthly consumption breakdown CSV.
- Retain audit log exports for 12 months for compliance team review.

Deadline: 2026-04-01 (procurement complete) to allow provisioning before contractor start date.
comments: 2026-03-10 Maya Chen: Opening request — attached vendor quote and project plan. Requesting procurement help and finance mapping. Urgent for April onboarding.

2026-03-11 Procurement (Anika Patel): Reviewed quote; vendor supports split invoicing but requires PO and explicit cost-center mapping on purchase order. Asked finance for approval and new GL mappings.
2026-03-11 Finance (Diego Alvarez): Confirmed RD-Analytics (GL 5201) and RD-Platform (GL 5210) can be used. Requested line-item pricing and total annual commitment before approval.

2026-03-12 Vendor Onboarding (Liam O'Connor): Reached out to Acme rep; asked for SCIM provisioning window and contractor seat activation policy. Vendor can enable SCIM within 48 hours of contract signature.
2026-03-12 Maya Chen: Confirmed contractor start window is 2026-04-15; can accept staged provisioning for permanent seats first then contractors. Asked procurement to prioritize PO issuance.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-11: Verified vendor supports per-seat ephemeral pool via API token; they bill based on highest concurrent seat usage in the month. Need to confirm whether contractor ephemeral seats will count toward peak billing — vendor says yes unless configured as "transparent contractors" (requires separate license SKU).

2026-03-11: Confirmed Redwood's SCIM default group mapping will create 'RD-Researchers' and 'RD-Contractors' groups; vendor requires group names to match exactly — will include mapping instructions in PO.
2026-03-12: Finance requested amortized monthly cost breakdown for headcount forecasting. Procurement to request 12-month monthly burn schedule from vendor before final approval.

2026-03-12: Risk: If vendor's billing counts ephemeral contractor seats toward peak, we may exceed budget. Mitigation: negotiate contractor SKU or time-bound discount; procurement to push for separate contractor SKU or billing exception.
Related docs and links checked: vendor SLA, procurement playbook, SCIM runbook.
resolution: (Pending) PO draft prepared and routed to Finance for approval. Procurement will negotiate contractor SKU to avoid peak-billing exposure. After sign-off, vendor will be asked to enable SCIM and set up groups for RD-Researchers and RD-Contractors. Final action items: 1) Finance approval and PO issuance, 2) Vendor contract signature, 3) SCIM provisioning window scheduled, 4) Assign SCIM owner for RD team. Target resolution date: 2026-03-25.
next_steps: Procurement to submit PO draft to Finance by 2026-03-13.
Procurement to negotiate contractor SKU and get revised quote by 2026-03-16.
Onboarding/Identity team to reserve SCIM provisioning slot week of 2026-03-22.
Maya Chen to provide final seat roster (permanent vs contractor) by 2026-03-18.
